limitations: Bounded test only; re-enablement, counter rearming or another cloud batch requires a new reviewed scope.
Source timestamps may be stale despite a successful poll; UI accurately labels that distinction.
Five-minute rate is configured; the short enabled window does not prove exact five-minute dispatch timing. Async delivery can duplicate invocation attempts, while raw/state outputs remain idempotent.
Hourly automatic Glue/export refresh is not implemented or enabled; cross-invocation batch versioning remains owner work.
Historical Superset panels remain on their previously accepted source; latest view is a separate real API-backed snapshot.
Telegram staging/E2E remains owned by Khue; no SNS, Telegram or deployed bot changes were performed.
Public redistribution for the network sources remains uncleared; API is private IAM-authenticated.
